name: Local Models
tagline: Put a model on this Mac that fits it, and point your bots at it.
blurb: Reads what this Mac can actually run (its memory, its free disk, whether Ollama is already there), recommends one model from a tier table, installs the runtime with your approval, and pulls the model with a cancel button and a progress bar. Then your chats and your bots' work can run on it: free, private, offline. It never starts a download that cannot land, and it tells you a model is too big before a byte moves.
capabilities: Too big is said before the download
Free and private, nothing leaves the Mac

bot.helpsWith: Puts a model on this Mac that fits it, and points your bots at it: free, private, offline.

jobs.name: Recommend a model
jobs.prompt: Recommend ONE local model for this Mac using the local-model-tiers skill, from the measured facts in $HOME/Library/Application Support/Operator/LocalModels/fit.json. If that file is missing, say so and stop: the person needs to run Check this Mac first. Write pick.json (to that same folder AND to ./outbox/pick.json) and ./outbox/recommendation.md exactly as the skill describes. Download nothing. Install nothing. State the numbers you used.

jobs.name: Install Ollama
capabilities: Starts it as your user, never sudo

jobs.name: Pull the model
capabilities: Cancel stops it, next run resumes
